prompt:
Our dev team has accumulated a big mess of markdown notes in `/workspace/dev_notes`. Everything is dumped flat in one folder — React, Vue, CSS, Node, Python, databases, Docker, algorithms, all mixed together. We need this cleaned up properly.

Please reorganize the notes into a logical topic-based structure using numbered folder names (like `01_something/`, `02_something/`). The folders should have sub-folders where it makes sense. After reorganizing, add cross-reference links between related notes — use the wiki-style double-bracket format, and put those link sections at the **bottom** of each file, not the top. The links need to go both ways: if note A references note B, note B should also reference note A. Finally, clean up any empty directories left behind.

The goal is a clean, navigable knowledge base where related topics are visibly connected.
